svg.title: Ziyi (Ellen) Zhou — statistician and data engineer, Montréal
svg.desc: Hand-drawn plate: Mont-Tremblant in winter seen across a river, with a lit café on the near bank, falling snow and a small return-level curve sketched in the sky. On the left: Ziyi (Ellen) Zhou, statistician and data engineer in Montréal, modelling rare, high-impact events.
